==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Aoping:''' Look at that tree over there.
:'''Aoping:''' Remember when it was just a sapling? Now look at it, all grown up and flourishing.
:'''Aoping:''' Jinzhou's farming has really taken off thanks to the hard work of the agriculture department.
:'''Aoping:''' I mean, back in the day, we'd hustle to plant before Spring Loong Festival and wait until the [[Moon-chasing Festival]] to reap our crops.
:'''Aoping:''' But now, we can harvest in summer or fall, with fields full of golden grain swaying in the breeze. Pretty awesome, right?
:'''Aoping:''' Do you think this is a good time?
{{Dialogue End}}
